My dear [Mrs Coleridge](../persons.html#348)
Alas, I have had so much Tyrol in the Monthly Packet as I am writing to tell [Mrs Prichard](../persons.html#1893) I find no series of travels ever answers, people do not keep up their interest - though single papers succeed well.
I hope [Bishop Patteson’s life](../books.html#102) will be out in a few week’s time.

How soon do you return to Mapledurham for I should like my [‘Cousin Edward’](../persons.html#332) as he insists on my calling him to have one of the first copies sent out

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed in pencil 1873.
